issues.description: The reference solution for Aufgabe 07 does not join Gemeinde and Schwimmbad on their gemeindeschluessel, causing a Cartesian product between all Gemeinden and all Freibäder. This contradicts the problem statement which asks for the names of Gemeinden that have a 'Freibad' and the names of the respective Freibäder (i.e. only matching pairs). Students following the solution will obtain incorrect results and may be confused about the required join.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution query to join Gemeinde and Schwimmbad on their key (Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel). For example: SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde JOIN Schwimmbad ON Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel WHERE Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'; This ensures only Gemeinden that actually host the listed Freibäder are returned.
